description: For countable \(L\) and \(M\), and countable \(\alpha\), the actual sentence at rank \(\alpha\) conjoins \(\phi^\alpha_{\varnothing}\) with the universal closures of \(\phi^\alpha_{\bar a}\to\phi^{\alpha+1}_{\bar a}\) over all finite tuples \(\bar a\) of \(M\). Tuple indices add no language constants.
